description: Repaint this band so the arctic ice and snow at the top transition smoothly downward into a snowy alpine basin with grey snow-capped mountains and the first dark evergreen treeline at the bottom. Remove the straight horizontal boundary line where the bright ice meets the paler snow; the snow should read as one continuous field grading from ice to mountain. Keep the same white, pale-blue, grey and dark-green palette and the same pixel-art style as the surroundings; no straight line and no speckled band should remain.
